message.reasoning:
We need to see if policy covers this. The user: "Our last invoice still lists the old office. Can you correct it and resend?" They want correction of past invoice and resend. Policy: DOC-003 part 2: Meridian does not reissue invoices already generated — correction applies forward only. Part 3: Customers who need a corrected copy of a past invoice for their own records, rather than a reissue, can request one through support. So answer: cannot reissue, but can request corrected copy via support. So we can answer: we cannot reissue; we can provide corrected copy upon request. That answers. It's within policy. So we can post_reply.

Write short answer: explain that we cannot reissue past invoice; we can provide corrected copy through support. Also mention that future invoices will have updated details after updating company details.

Thus post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"I’m sorry, but we can’t re‑issue a past invoice. We can provide you with a corrected copy of the previous invoice for your records – just let us know you need it and we’ll send it over. Any changes you make to your company details will apply to invoices generated from that point forward."}
